chores.name: pr-board
chores.probe: gh pr list --state open --json number --jq ".[].number" | sort -n | while read n; do gh pr view $n --json number,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup --jq "\"\(.number):\(.mergeStateStatus):\([.statusCheckRollup[]?|.conclusion//.state]|sort|join(\"/\"))\""; done | paste -sd" " -
